preconditions.description: The number of vertices n and edges m are within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query consists of two distinct vertices within the valid range [1, n].

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and 1 <= c <= m for a, b, c in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two valid vertices and has a valid color index.
No two edges have the same pair of vertices and the same color.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly q lines, one for each query.

postconditions.expression: all(int(stdout.strip().splitlines()[i]) == sum(1 for c in unique_colors if is_connected_by_color(queries[i][0], queries[i][1], c, edges)) for i in range(q))
postconditions.description: For each query i, the output line i contains the count of unique colors c such that vertices ui and vi are in the same connected component when considering only edges of color c.
